00154 float Env::lookup(float time) const throw()
00155 {
00156     const int numTimes = getTimes().size();
00157     const int numLevels = getLevels().size();
00158     const int lastLevel = numLevels-1;
00159     
00160     ugen_assert(numTimes == lastLevel);
00161     
00162     if(numLevels < 1) return 0.f;
00163     if(time <= 0.f || numTimes == 0) return getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(0);
00164     
00165     float lastTime = 0.f;
00166     float stageTime = 0.f;
00167     int stageIndex = 0;
00168     
00169     while(stageTime < time && stageIndex < numTimes)
00170     {
00171         lastTime = stageTime;
00172         stageTime += getTimes().getSampleUnchecked(stageIndex);
00173         stageIndex++;
00174     }
00175     
00176     if(stageIndex > numTimes) return getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(lastLevel);
00177         
00178     float level0 = getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(stageIndex-1);
00179     float level1 = getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(stageIndex);
00180     
00181     EnvCurve curve = getCurves()[stageIndex-1];
00182     EnvCurve::CurveType type = curve.getType();
00183     float curveValue = curve.getCurve();
00184     
00185     if((lastTime - stageTime)==0.f)
00186     {
00187        return level1;
00188     }
00189     else if(type == EnvCurve::Linear)
00190     {
00191         return linlin(time, lastTime, stageTime, level0, level1);
00192     }
00193     else if(type == EnvCurve::Numerical)
00194     {
00195         if(abs(curveValue) <= 0.001)
00196         {
00197             return linlin(time, lastTime, stageTime, level0, level1);
00198         }
00199         else
00200         {           
00201             float pos = (time-lastTime) / (stageTime-lastTime);
00202             float denom = 1.f - std::exp(curveValue);
00203             float numer = 1.f - std::exp(pos * curveValue);
00204             return level0 + (level1 - level0) * (numer/denom);
00205         }
00206     }
00207     else if(type == EnvCurve::Sine)
00208     {
00209         return linsin(time, lastTime, stageTime, level0, level1);
00210     }
00211     else if(type == EnvCurve::Exponential)
00212     {
00213         return linexp(time, lastTime, stageTime, level0, level1);
00214     }
00215     else if(type == EnvCurve::Welch)
00216     {
00217         return linwelch(time, lastTime, stageTime, level0, level1);
00218     }
00219     else
00220     {
00221         // Empty or Step
00222         return level1;
00223     }
00224 }

00226 Env::operator Buffer () const throw()
00227 {
00228     float duration = getTimes().sum();
00229     int size = UGen::getSampleRate() * duration;
00230     Buffer buffer = BufferSpec(size, 1, false);
00231     float *bufferSamples = buffer.getData();
00232     
00233     double time = 0.0;
00234     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++, time += UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate())
00235     {
00236         *bufferSamples++ = lookup(time);
00237     }
00238     
00239     return buffer;
00240 }
00241 
00242 void Env::writeToBuffer(Buffer& buffer, const int channel) const throw()
00243 {
00244     double duration = getTimes().sum();
00245     int size = buffer.size();
00246     
00247     ugen_assert(size > 0);
00248     ugen_assert(buffer.getNumChannels() > 0);
00249     
00250     float *bufferSamples = buffer.getData(channel % buffer.getNumChannels());
00251     
00252     double timeInc = duration / size;
00253     double time = 0.0;
00254     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++, time += timeInc)
00255     {
00256         *bufferSamples++ = lookup(time);
00257     }
00258 }

00260 Env Env::linen(const double attackTime, 
00261                const double sustainTime, 
00262                const double releaseTime, 
00263                const double sustainLevel,
00264                EnvCurve const& curve) throw()
00265 {
00266     ugen_assert(attackTime >= 0.0);
00267     ugen_assert(sustainTime >= 0.0);
00268     ugen_assert(releaseTime >= 0.0);
00269     ugen_assert(sustainLevel >= 0.0);
00270     ugen_assert((attackTime + sustainTime + releaseTime) > 0.0);
00271     
00272     return Env(Buffer(0.0, sustainLevel, sustainLevel, 0.0), 
00273                Buffer(attackTime, sustainTime, releaseTime),
00274                curve);
00275 }
